_comment: Development overlay for the Universe tab, the third embedded web-application slot.
This file no longer carries the shipped defaults. The address, the tab name, whether the tab
appears and which bridge permissions it holds are all fields on WebAppSlot::universe() in
src/slic3r/GUI/WebAppPanel.cpp, because this file is excluded from the installer and a
customer machine therefore has nothing to read. The same goes for the storage hosts the page
may fetch a model from: that is WebAppSlot::download_hosts, and it has to be compiled in
because the host belongs to the deployment rather than to the product.
Read once, on the first run of a build that has the tab -- see WebAppPanel::ensure_seeded and
the universe_app_seeded key. To point the tab at a local copy of the site set
ORCA_UNIVERSE_APP_URL, which wins over both the slot and this file and is never written back.
_extra_origins_comment: Additional https origins the tab may NAVIGATE to. Navigable is NOT trusted: the bridge
session token is injected only on the slot's own address. Google sign-in is deliberately
absent -- it needs a popup the web view cannot serve, so the page hands sign-in to the user's
real browser and collects the session back.
